UPSTREAM: ath9k: fix buffer overrun for ar9287 [ Upstream commit 83d6f1f15f8cce844b0a131cbc63e444620e48b5 ] Code that was added back in 2.6.38 has an obvious overflow when accessing a static array, and at the time it was added only a code comment was put in front of it as a reminder to have it reviewed properly. This has not happened, but gcc-6 now points to the specific overflow: drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath9k/eeprom.c: In function 'ath9k_hw_get_gain_boundaries_pdadcs': drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath9k/eeprom.c:483:44: error: array subscript is above array bounds [-Werror=array-bounds] maxPwrT4[i] = data_9287[idxL].pwrPdg[i][4]; ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~ It turns out that the correct array length exists in the local 'intercepts' variable of this function, so we can just use that instead of hardcoding '4', so this patch changes all three instances to use that variable. The other two instances were already correct, but it's more consistent this way. BUG=chromium:702746 TEST=build with clang for edgar Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de> Fixes: 940cd2c12ebf ("ath9k_hw: merge the ar9287 version of ath9k_hw_get_gain_boundaries_pdadcs") Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net> Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org> (cherry picked from commit a317579bb62ec6c1cb6bd7e5d0d8a25a746832f2) Signed-off-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> Change-Id: I9b7b8f1453893fa9b08002c0979674e80453180b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/493789 Commit-Ready: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> Tested-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>

Adds recovery_count and first_active_omaha_ping_sent. recovery_count is an integer in RW_VPD and is increased everytime the device is recovered. This CL adds proper code for reading its value. Its value is sent as an UMA metric once a day. first_active_omaha_ping_sent is a boolean in RW_VPD that is used to decide whether to send the first active ping to omaha or not. This CL adds proper code for reading its value and setting it to "true" after first active ping is sent or if it does not exits. BUG=chromium:717788 TEST=cros_workon_make --test; Deployed on a device and made sure they are read and writen properly.
